# ASHA Experiences

> ASHA Experiences runs small-group international retreats for women, combining yoga, sound healing, ceremony, guided women's circles and time in nature. It is run by two co-founders, Ashley and Shannon. Most women come solo. Groups are intimate.

Website: https://ashaexperiences.com
Email: connect@ashaexperiences.com
Instagram: https://instagram.com/asha_experiences

## Upcoming retreats

- [Into the Wild — Kenya, November 28 – December 4, 2027](https://ashaexperiences.com/retreats/kenya): 7 days / 6 nights at Ol Pejeta Conservancy, Kenya. Groups are capped at 10 women. Daily sunrise and sunset safari drives, yoga and meditation overlooking the plains, workshops, ceremonies and women's circles, a visit to the Northern White Rhino Sanctuary, Spinners and Weavers, and a Kenyan cooking class. Stay is in a two-bedroom safari cottage, sharing a bedroom with one other woman, ensuite bathrooms. $6,900 per person (shared room); reserve with a $1,000 deposit. Includes private ground transport to and from Nairobi and all meals. Not included: flights to Nairobi, a Nairobi hotel the night before, travel insurance, the Kenya eVisa (around $50) and gratuities.
- [Sacred Sands — Morocco, November 29 – December 5, 2026](https://ashaexperiences.com/retreats/morocco): 7 days near Agadir, Morocco. Yoga, sound healing, desert adventures, Moroccan culture and sisterhood. From $3,200 per person depending on room.

All retreat payments are non-refundable.
